# Fresh event lane: October 6–10, 2026

Five proposed cards and one separately logged lead. Events are date-bounded to the assigned window; reports published later are used only when they document an event in the window. The diesel tax executive order was excluded because the official record dates it October 5.

The frozen export (7,143 records) and prior fresh set (84 cards through September 30) were screened for title/date and event-level near matches. See each card's duplicate review and `validation-report.md` for the limits of this comparison. All cards remain `PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED`; no live or canonical data was changed.

Source limitations are explicit in `research-log.jsonl` and card source verification fields. The Iran pledge has a Reuters-carried report whose article page was inaccessible; the shipyard announcement remains a lead pending primary contract/funding documentation.
